connector.name: Rigol DHO824 Oscilloscope
connector.registryDescription: Control and query Rigol DHO824 oscilloscope for waveform capture and measurements
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image rigol-dho824-mcp:0.1.143-main.2b177ae. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the aimoda account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: RIGOL_RESOURCE
env.description: VISA resource string for connecting to the oscilloscope (e.g., 'TCPIP0::192.168.1.100::inst0::INSTR').

env.name: RIGOL_BEEPER_ENABLED
env.description: Enable or disable oscilloscope beeper sounds

env.name: RIGOL_TEMP_DIR
env.description: Host-side path for returned file paths. The container writes to /tmp/rigol internally and translates paths to this value in responses. Must match the host path in your -v mount. Required for Docker usage.
